messages:
Nora Mills: Need a tight copy pass for three deployment pages (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Goals: engineer-first heroes, a compact benchmark badge, and clear inbound routing for webinar vs demo vs trial. 48h turnaround.
Diego Ramos: Agreed. One-line hero per page, plus a shared economics strip. Keep microcopy to one sentence.
Priya Shah: Benchmark draft: '~38% lower token cost with caching + batching; 95th latency ≈ <220ms in our tests.' Will add a one-line methodology for the footer.
Lia Park: Routing plan: capture mode_interest, intent (trial|demo|webinar), company_size, email, utm_campaign. Webinar -> marketing list; demo (dedicated/private) -> sales webhook with requires_sales=true.
Theo (Design): I'll build three hero variants and a small badge for the benchmark. CTA pattern: page-specific CTA text but single modal that pre-selects mode from path.
Diego Ramos: Hero copy candidates: Hosted: 'Start fast with our hosted API.' Dedicated: 'Reserve capacity with SLA-backed throughput.' Private: 'Deploy inference inside your VPC or on-prem.'
Nora Mills: Good. Make voice active and concise; Diego + Priya pair on final microcopy. Lia to own form fields & redirect rules. Theo to drop assets in /marketing/landing-assets.
Priya Shah: Methodology note (footer): '8k seq tests, A/B vs baseline lib, quantization + batching enabled.'
ops-bot: Reminder: staging deploy window tomorrow 01:00-03:00 UTC. Tag PRs.
Nora Mills: Timeline: Day1 drafts + schema, Day2 design + dev handoff. Publish target next Tue. Meeting tomorrow 10:30 to finalize. :thumbsup:
